newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open mixed, cautious on yen, US data.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open mixed, cautious on yen, US data.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened mixed on Friday, with participants cautious due to the yen's slight firming against the dollar overnight and forthcoming U.S. jobs data scheduled for release later in the day, brokers said.
Selling pressure between 20,500 and 21,000 capped the key market index, they added.
At 0005 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was down 17.10 points or 0.08 percent at 20,471.05, while June Nikkei futures were up 30 yen at 20,500.
